svg.text: One mask stage. Every mask edge, band and tube end sits outside the bag, so any leak there runs outward.
A. Side section of one cartridge
Mask sleeve: masks wrapped round the tube
Tube: cut bottle or rolled card
outer flap onto the inner one
C. Detail at a band: every edge leaks outward
Pressure falls from bag to tube to open air,
so both leaks here run outward.
dirty air escapes to open air
filtered air escapes to open air
D. Stages in series: one bag per cartridge
Each bag holds one cartridge and sits in open air. Two cartridges in one bag would run in parallel.
leak into the clean side: critical
Schematic, not to scale: layer thicknesses are exaggerated.
